paraphrase: Salutation to that Kṛṣṇa, lustrous like a fresh rain-cloud, stealer of the garments of the cowherd girls, the seed of the tree of saṃsāra.

original.text: nūtana-jaladhara-rucaye gopabadhūṭī-dukūla-caurāya / tasmai kṛṣṇāya namaḥ saṃsāramahīruhasya bījāya

speaker: Viśvanātha

paraphrase: Substance, quality, motion, universal with particularity, inherence and absence — seven categories are declared.
